factors.description: A sandboxed agent is acting outside its sandbox.
factors.remedy: Stop it now: a sandboxed agent is acting outside its sandbox
factors.atlas_description: Evade sandboxing / act beyond declared confinement

factors.description: Live connections look like scanning a network or host.
factors.remedy: Investigate now: this connection pattern is what scanning looks like

factors.description: Can run arbitrary commands.
factors.remedy: Deny shell and grant only the commands it needs

factors.description: Can write outside anything it declared.
factors.remedy: Narrow the write grant to one directory
factors.atlas_description: Persistence / tampering via broad file write

factors.description: Reaches many destinations with no egress policy.
factors.remedy: Add an egress allowlist for its model endpoint

factors.description: A credential is readable by this agent (first is worth more).
factors.remedy: Move the credential where this owner cannot read it

factors.description: Shell plus a reachable credential is a complete path out.
factors.remedy: Break the chain: deny shell, or move the credential out of reach
factors.atlas_description: Exfiltration via a reachable credential and outbound path

factors.description: Can invoke another agent, extending its reach a second hop.
factors.remedy: Remove the connector that reaches the other agent

factors.description: Touched a resource its own config never granted.
factors.remedy: Either grant the path or find out why it was touched

factors.description: Matched a local path rule you defined; critical rules force the score to 100.
factors.remedy: Review or remove the watchlist rule that matched

factors.description: Exposes a listening socket beyond loopback.
factors.remedy: Close or bind the listener to loopback

factors.description: A known offensive utility is running below the agent.
factors.remedy: Stop the agent and inspect why it launched the tool

factors.description: The process tree has expanded beyond the configured threshold.
factors.remedy: Stop the agent and inspect its child-process loop

factors.description: A raw address is contacted on a port commonly used by shells or implants.
factors.remedy: Inspect the raw destination and stop the agent if it is unexplained

factors.description: The agent has reached another private-network host.
factors.remedy: Confirm the internal peer is expected and restrict lateral reach

factors.description: The agent contacted a cloud instance metadata service.
factors.remedy: Block instance-metadata access unless this agent explicitly requires it

factors.description: A credential was actually opened, not merely reachable.
factors.remedy: Rotate the credential and remove the agent's access

factors.description: A persistence location was modified.
factors.remedy: Remove the persistence entry and inspect the agent

factors.description: Topgent code or policy was modified by an agent.
factors.remedy: Stop the agent and verify Topgent from a trusted copy
factors.atlas_description: Impair defenses by modifying the monitor

factors.description: The agent is using an asset you explicitly disallowed.
factors.remedy: Stop or reconfigure the agent so it no longer uses this asset
factors.atlas_description: Use of a locally disallowed component
